# spydersoftidentity_scope (Data Source)

Looks up an API scope by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spydersoftidentity_scope" "email" {
  name = "email"
}

output "email_scope_claims" {
  value = data.spydersoftidentity_scope.email.user_claims
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique scope name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description shown on the consent screen.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the consent screen.
- `emphasize` (Boolean) Emphasize the scope on the consent screen.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scope is enabled.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom key/value properties on the scope.
- `required` (Boolean) The scope cannot be deselected on the consent screen.
- `show_in_discovery_document` (Boolean) Whether the scope is listed in the discovery document.
- `user_claims` (Set of String) User claim types included in tokens issued for this scope.
